implementation: engine/rust/question_selection.rs select; read-only faithful reproduction for one rated band with positive weight
rules: Fresh usable candidates exclude history/current prefix before select.
First SHA256 uniform chooses nonempty positively weighted band.
Second uniform chooses candidate in that band.
Unconfigured weights choose first candidate; no positive rated band uses unrated fallback.
assumptions: No learner histories/policy weights captured; tested no-history and half-excluded scenarios.
New questions have no database entity IDs; assign synthetic numeric IDs in UUID order, state no actual future ordering claim.
Captured inventory includes 13 original source and 2 historical generated questions; source questions are not relabeled.
Positive requested-band weights leave all fresh same-band cases eligible; arbitrary histories can shrink any finite pool, so no guarantee for every possible history.
